actionLog: This request had two halves, delivered as two separate PRs: #7 lets a dev user edit their own comment's text from the sidebar, and #9 adds the "Jynx commenter" permission tier (admin can grant a regular dev user permission to leave Jynx-meta feedback, previously admin-only).

replies.text: Partial progress: every dev user now has their own comments view (the sidebar, with an Open/Done split and a Just me filter), can jump to a comment's location, and can reply to any comment thread. Editing your own comment text, and the separate 'jynx commenter' permission tier for regular dev users, are still open.
